plain_statement: The plane of order 3 (13 points, 13 lines). A circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, true at every incident point-line pair and false at every generic maximal false input (a point set, not inside one line, with all lines missing it on, where every outside point lies on such a line and no point lies on all of them) has at least 51 OR gates.
title: A step toward: Order-3 plane: every fan-in-two AND/OR circuit true at incident pairs and false at all generic maximal false inputs has at least 64 gates
